title: Turn Any Folder Into a Local Website
description: Use Python's built-in HTTP server on 127.0.0.1 for a localhost-only preview, with an explicit note about deliberate LAN access.
hook: This folder can become a localhost-only website with one command.

scenes.headline: A REAL LOCAL WEBSITE
scenes.narration: Turn this folder into a localhost-only website with one command. No upload, account, or ceremonial dashboard.
scenes.caption: A real server. Local only.

scenes.headline: BIND IT TO LOCALHOST
scenes.narration: In a harmless test folder, run the command shown. The bind flag restricts the server to 127 dot 0 dot 0 dot 1: this machine only.
scenes.caption: Bind explicitly to localhost.

scenes.headline: LOCALHOST:8000
scenes.narration: Open localhost colon eight thousand. This real captured page came from that folder, and the button works normally.
scenes.caption: localhost:8000 — actually running

scenes.headline: LOCAL IS NOT LAN
scenes.narration: Remove the bind flag only when you deliberately want LAN access. Other devices may connect, so serve only safe files.
scenes.caption: LAN access should be deliberate.

scenes.headline: DONE? CONTROL C.
scenes.narration: Press Control C when finished. The captured process stops cleanly. Software that understands when to leave. Remarkable.
scenes.caption: Start locally. Stop cleanly.
